title: WSL eth0 receive under 5 KiB/s for 2 minutes

model.expr: rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="workstation-node",device="eth0"}[30s]) / 1024 + on() group_left() 1000000 * (((max(net_probe_public_ok) == bool 1) and on() (time() - max(net_probe_last_run_timestamp_seconds) < 180)) or vector(0))

annotations.summary: WSL eth0 receive under 5 KiB/s for 2 minutes
annotations.description: The VM's eth0 has moved under 5 KiB/s for two minutes and the active probe (native-net-probe, once a minute) does not show the Internet reachable, or has gone stale. While the probe is fresh and reaches a public resolver the value is raised by 1e6, so an idle weekend cannot fire it. Basis: HOST-HEALTH-ADDENDUM-NETWORK-20261014.md; records: ALERT-NET-SILENT-20261014.md, ALERT-NET-PROBE-20261014.md (host-capacity record); tests: tools/alert_replay.py and changes-20261014/promtool/net-silent-confirmed.test.yaml.
